subject: pri-info
title: (R)PRI.INFO.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 85 ((AF)D-13). PRI-INFO (principle information) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From INFO-DY: RT-DY (reality dynamics) and ATTN (attraction). From TH-CONT: INFO-DY. From RT-DY: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and ACT-TR (actual transformation). From ACT-TR: CUL-TR-S and INFO-PROJ (information projection). From CUL-TR-S: AFI (affinity insight).
